Users can customize warhead yield and other parameters to display various effects, including blast overpressure, thermal radiation, and radioactive fallout.

Name: Discover ESA: Interactive Tours & Virtual Visits
Desc: Discover the European Space Agency (ESA) through engaging interactive tours and virtual visits, offering an immersive way to explore its work and facilities.

Name: Free Music Archive: Royalty-Free Music for Content Creators
Desc: Free Music Archive (FMA) offers a vast library of royalty-free and free-to-download music from independent artists, empowering content creators to find soundtracks for their projects while supporting musicians worldwide.

Name: Google AI Studio: Platform for Gemini AI
Desc: Google AI Studio is a platform for accessing and utilizing the latest Google Gemini AI models, enabling users to work with advanced artificial intelligence capabilities.

Name: Google Labs: Home for AI Experiments
Desc: Google Labs is Google's official hub for showcasing and allowing users to try out its cutting-edge artificial intelligence experiments. It features a diverse collection of innovative AI-powered tools and prototypes designed for various applications, from filmmaking to personal styling.

Name: CutList Optimizer: Online Cutting Plan Generator
Desc: CutList Optimizer is an online tool designed to generate efficient cutting plans for panels and other materials, helping users minimize waste and optimize stock utilization.

Name: SketchUp 3D Warehouse: 3D Models for Twinmotion
Desc: The SketchUp 3D Warehouse is a comprehensive online archive providing 3D models for import. It specifically caters to users looking for models to integrate into Twinmotion.

Name: Statcounter Global Stats: Worldwide Market Share Statistics
Link: Statcounter Global Stats - Browser, OS, Search Engine including Mobile Usage Share
Desc: Statcounter Global Stats provides extensive worldwide market share statistics for web browsers, operating systems, and search engines, including mobile usage. It offers customizable charts and data downloads across various regions and timeframes.

Name: Custom Fourier Series Visualizer
Desc: This web application is a Fourier Series visualizer that allows users to explore various waveforms like square, triangle, and sawtooth. Users can also define custom series by adjusting parameters such as numerator, denominator, and coefficient.

Name: Quantum Moves 2: An Engaging Game of Quantum Phenomena
Desc: This page features "Quantum Moves 2," an engaging game designed to let players interact with and manipulate quantum phenomena. It provides a unique, hands-on approach to understanding the principles of the quantum world through play.

Name: Online Gravity Simulator: Explore & Create Astronomical Simulations
Desc: This online gravity simulator allows users to explore a vast array of astronomical scenarios, from exoplanets and spacecraft orbits to galactic collisions. Users can also create their own simulations, making it a powerful tool for visualizing celestial mechanics.

Name: Interactive Math, Physics & Engineering Applets
Desc: Explore a diverse collection of interactive JavaScript applets designed to visualize and explain complex concepts across various fields of mathematics, physics, and engineering. Topics covered range from wave mechanics and electromagnetism to quantum mechanics and thermodynamics.

Name: myPhysicsLab: Interactive Physics Simulations
Desc: myPhysicsLab offers a diverse collection of interactive, real-time physics simulations, allowing users to explore concepts from basic springs and pendulums to complex rigid body dynamics. Users can manipulate objects, adjust parameters like gravity, and customize or share their experimental setups.

Name: Fractal Lab: Interactive WebGL Fractal Explorer
Desc: Fractal Lab is an interactive online WebGL explorer that enables users to create and manipulate 2D and 3D fractals in real time. It offers extensive controls for navigation, parameter adjustment, and even direct editing of the GLSL shader formulas.

Name: CircuitLab: Online Circuit Design Software
Desc: This is an online circuit design software that enables users to edit and create circuits directly within their web browser.

Name: Matter.js Physics Engine: Online Demo
Desc: Explore an interactive online demo of the Matter.js physics engine, showcasing its capabilities through simulations like Newton's Cradle. This page allows users to experience the engine's physics in action.

Name: MathsIsFun.com: Interactive Math Learning Resources
Desc: MathsIsFun.com is a comprehensive educational website designed to make learning mathematics engaging and accessible for all ages. It offers a vast collection of resources, including interactive tools, games, worksheets, and clear explanations across a wide range of math topics.

Name: Teachable Machine: No-Code AI Model Training
Desc: Teachable Machine is a web-based tool that allows users to quickly train custom machine learning models for image and sound recognition without writing any code.

Name: Uptrends: Free Website Performance & Monitoring Tools
Desc: This page from Uptrends offers a collection of free, practical tools for comprehensive website screening and monitoring. These tools help users assess their website's availability, performance, and technical health from various global vantage points.

Name: PhET: Free Online STEM Simulations
Desc: PhET provides a comprehensive collection of free, award-winning online simulations from the University of Colorado, covering physics, chemistry, biology, geoscience, and mathematics. These interactive tools are designed to facilitate engaging learning experiences across various STEM disciplines.

Name: TextFX: Creative Text Tools
Desc: TextFX is a Google-hosted platform providing various tools for generating and exploring creative text effects and transformations.

Name: Satellite Archive Tool: Free High-Resolution Satellite Images
Desc: This page provides access to free, high-resolution satellite images through a comprehensive satellite archive tool.

Name: NUKEMAP: Nuclear Bomb Impact Simulator
Desc: NUKEMAP is an interactive online simulator that allows users to detonate virtual nuclear bombs at any chosen location, visualizing the projected impacts of blast, thermal radiation, and radioactive fallout. This tool provides a powerful way to understand the devastating scale and various effects of nuclear detonations.

Name: Neal.fun: Engaging Online Creations
Desc: Neal.fun is a personal website by Neal showcasing a variety of unique web-based games and creative projects. It serves as a hub for his engaging online creations.

Name: Next-Generation Molecular Workbench: Visual, Interactive Science Simulations for Education
Desc: The Next-Generation Molecular Workbench provides visual, interactive online simulations designed for teaching and learning science across various fields like biology, chemistry, and physics. Users can explore dynamic models and computational experiments covering topics from molecular interactions to macroscopic phenomena.

Name: Gandalf: AI Jailbreaking Game
Desc: Gandalf is an engaging AI jailbreaking game designed to test your skills at finding and exploiting vulnerabilities in artificial intelligence systems. It challenges players to ethically "hack" the AI.

Name: Nicky Case: Interactive Simulations & Explorable Explanations
Desc: Nicky Case's website features a collection of interactive simulations and "explorable explanations" designed for curious and playful individuals to learn about complex topics from game theory to societal systems. Explore engaging projects that offer unique insights through immersive play.

Name: 3DLogoLab: Free Online 3D Rotating Logo Generator
Desc: 3DLogoLab offers a free online generator for creating custom 3D and rotating logos.

Name: R74n: Pixel Art Simulations & Digital Utilities
Desc: R74n is a website offering a diverse collection of engaging pixel-art simulations, unique games, and quirky utility tools.

Name: GenChess: Generate Unique AI Chess Pieces
Desc: GenChess is an AI-powered tool from Google Labs that allows users to create unique or unusual chess pieces. It leverages artificial intelligence to generate diverse and imaginative designs for these figures.

Name: n8n: AI Workflow Automation Platform for Technical Teams
Desc: n8n.io offers a powerful and flexible AI workflow automation platform for technical teams. It enables users to build multi-step AI agents and integrate over 500 applications using either code or a drag-and-drop interface, with options for self-hosting or cloud deployment.

Name: Staying: Interactive Code & Algorithm Visualization
Desc: Staying is an interactive platform providing real-time code visualization for Python, JavaScript, and C++. It allows users to visually understand how algorithms execute step-by-step.

Name: Natural Language Playlist: AI Spotify Playlist Generator
Desc: This website enables users to generate Spotify playlists by describing their desired music using natural language. It leverages AI to understand musical and cultural features, creating personalized mixtapes.

Name: Library of Babel: Every Possible Text Online
Desc: This online library is a digital realization of Jorge Luis Borges' "Library of Babel" concept. It simulates an infinite collection containing every possible permutation of characters, allowing users to browse, search, or discover random texts within its vast digital shelves.

Name: If the Moon Were One Pixel: Interactive Solar System Scale
Desc: This interactive visualization redefines scale by portraying the solar system as if the Moon were just one pixel, starkly revealing the immense, often incomprehensible distances and vast emptiness of space between celestial bodies.

Name: TopoExport: Online 3D Terrain Exporter
Desc: TopoExport is a web-based tool designed for exporting 3D terrain models. It provides a convenient solution for users needing to generate and download terrain data.

Name: The Pudding: Interactive Visual Explanations
Desc: The Pudding is a digital publication offering a collection of interactive and visual explanations, exploring a diverse array of topics through data-driven journalism and engaging storytelling. It transforms complex information into accessible and innovative experiences.

Name: The Bézier Game: Master Bézier Curves
Desc: Master the art of creating precise Bézier curves with The Bézier Game, an interactive online tool designed to help users practice and hone their pen tool skills.

Name: Napkin AI: Visual AI for Business Storytelling
Desc: Napkin AI is a visual AI tool that transforms text into a variety of engaging visuals like infographics, diagrams, and charts. It streamlines business storytelling by enabling users to quickly and effectively communicate ideas visually.

Name: MovieLens: Personalized Movie Recommendations
Desc: MovieLens is a non-commercial platform that provides personalized movie recommendations, allowing users to rate films and build custom taste profiles. Run by a research lab, it also offers rich movie data and advanced search tools, contributing to the development of new recommendation technologies.

Name: Gemini 3D Co-Drawing: AI-Powered 3D Object Drawing
Desc: This Hugging Face Space provides an AI-powered co-drawing tool, leveraging Gemini, for creating 3D objects.

Name: Voxtral: Reliable Audio Transcription
Desc: Voxtral is a Hugging Face Space designed for reliable audio transcription. It offers a dependable tool for accurately converting spoken content into text.

Name: Flourish: Interactive Data Visualization & Storytelling Platform
Desc: Flourish is a powerful, no-code data visualization platform designed to help users create interactive charts, maps, and multimedia content. It enables the transformation of complex data into engaging, shareable stories and visuals without requiring any coding skills.

Name: Chronas: Interactive Online History of Humanity
Desc: Chronas is an interactive online platform dedicated to exploring the extensive history of humanity, inviting users to "Enter History" and discover the past.

Name: Telescopius: Astronomy Tools & Astrophotography
Desc: Telescopius.com provides an astronomy tool primarily for simulating telescopes, also offering various resources for astrophotography.

Name: Traceroute-Online: Visual Network Path Mapping
Desc: Traceroute-Online.com offers an advanced visual traceroute tool that maps network paths on a world map, enriching the output with ASN and geolocation data for comprehensive network connectivity analysis from a remote server.

Name: FLUX Playground: AI Image Editor
Desc: FLUX Playground is an AI-powered online tool enabling users to edit and transform images using text instructions. It offers diverse functionalities, from basic adjustments like relighting and object removal to creative presets such as cartooning and style transformations.

Name: Hex Clock: Current Time as Dark Hex Colors
Desc: Explore a unique digital clock that converts the current time into a precise hexadecimal color, progressing through a specific 24-hour spectrum. This hex clock represents each moment as a distinct color code, often within a dark range.

Name: The World Wide Web Project: Original CERN Documentation
Desc: This page provides access to the foundational documentation of the original World Wide Web project from CERN, presented as part of a historical recreation of its early form. It outlines the project's ambitious goal of universal information access, its history, technical details, and software components.

Name: OneZoom: Interactive Tree of Life Explorer
Desc: Explore an interactive 'Tree of Life' that visually maps the evolutionary relationships and immense diversity of all known species on Earth. This comprehensive explorer allows users to navigate through the vast biological classification, from microscopic life forms to complex organisms.

Name: Free Online STL Viewer
Desc: This is a free, feature-rich online STL viewer designed for conveniently rendering and exploring 3D models directly in your web browser.

Name: EOS LandViewer: Latest Satellite Imagery
Desc: EOS LandViewer provides a portal to access the latest and most up-to-date satellite imagery in near real-time. This service offers current views of Earth from space.

Name: YouTube Atlas: Interactive Map of Channel Networks
Desc: YouTube Atlas offers an interactive visualization mapping all YouTube channels and their connections. It allows users to explore the intricate network and relationships between different channels.

Name: Google's Experimental AI Learning Tool: Explore Artificial Intelligence
Desc: Sign up for Google's experimental AI learning tool on this page, designed to help users explore and understand artificial intelligence.

Name: LinkReceipt: Easy Link Tracking
Desc: LinkReceipt.com provides a simple, secure service that allows users to track if and when a shared link has been opened, offering insights into content engagement. This easy-to-use platform requires no sign-up or login.

Name: Cheatography: Free Cheat Sheets & Quick References
Desc: Cheatography.com provides a vast collection of over 6,000 free cheat sheets, revision aids, and quick references across diverse subjects like programming, software, business, and education. Users can download these concise guides or create and share their own for various topics.

Name: Google Labs FX: AI Tools for Creative Media
Desc: Google Labs FX provides a suite of AI-powered tools designed to help users create and transform content, including generating videos, transforming text into images, and bringing new musical ideas to life.

Name: Experiments Hub: Innovative 3D Web UI Examples
Desc: This "Experiments Hub" showcases a collection of extraordinary and innovative 3D Web user interface examples.

Name: Online WebGL Fractal Explorer
Desc: This online WebGL and JavaScript renderer allows users to interactively explore various fractals. Features include clicking to center, mouse wheel zooming, and a fullscreen option, all designed for modern browsers.

Name: BuildCores: 3D PC Builder & Part Picker
Desc: BuildCores offers an online 3D PC builder and part picker, enabling users to configure and visualize their custom computer setups.

Name: Google Illuminate: AI-Powered Audio for Personalized Learning
Desc: Google's Illuminate allows users to create realistic AI-powered audio discussions from their own data, providing a personalized way to learn or engage with content.

Name: Google NotebookLM: AI Assistant for Your Content
Desc: NotebookLM is Google's AI chatbot designed to help you interact with your own uploaded documents and information. This tool allows users to gain intelligent insights, summaries, and answers directly from their specific content.

Name: Magic Resume: AI-Driven Resume Editor
Desc: Magic Resume is a free, AI-driven online editor designed to help users quickly create professional resumes. It offers smart grammar checks, professional suggestions, and secure local data storage, emphasizing user privacy and ease of use.

Name: GenType: AI-Powered Custom Alphabet Generator
Desc: GenType is a Google Labs experiment that leverages artificial intelligence to generate unique alphabets, allowing users to create letters from virtually any concept or object.

Name: BestSimilar.com: Find Similar Movies & TV Shows
Desc: BestSimilar.com is a recommendation service designed to help you discover new movies and TV shows by finding similar titles based on your preferences or by exploring various themes. It provides curated lists and suggestions to assist in choosing your next watch.

Name: Firebase Studio: The Full-Stack AI Workspace
Desc: Firebase Studio is an AI-powered workspace designed to accelerate the full-stack development lifecycle, enabling users to build backends, front ends, and mobile applications with comprehensive AI assistance. It streamlines the creation of various apps, including AI-driven ones, by leveraging AI agents like Gemini for coding, debugging, and testing.

Name: BioDigital: Interactive 3D Anatomy & Disease Platform
Desc: BioDigital offers an interactive 3D software platform that provides comprehensive visualizations of human anatomy, diseases, and treatments, making complex health information engaging and easy to understand.

Name: Interactive Solar System Explorer
Desc: This website offers an interactive exploration of the solar system, allowing users to visualize and learn about celestial bodies and their movements.

Name: Solar System 3D Texture Collection
Desc: Discover a vast collection of high-resolution 3D textures for planets, moons, and other celestial bodies throughout our Solar System.

Name: Imaginary Teleprompter: Free Professional Online Solution
Desc: This online teleprompter provides a free and professional solution with extensive customization for text display, speed, and orientation. It's designed for diverse setups, supporting rich text editing, multi-screen use, and local data management.
